title: FLA import: scale9Grid not decoded — 9-slice scaling lost on round-trip
description:
The symbol model supports scale9Grid (a { left, top, right, bottom } rectangle) and compile.ts emits DefineScalingGrid (tag 78) correctly. However flash8-binary.ts had no code to read it from the FLA binary stream, and flash8-import.ts always left scale9Grid as null for imported symbols.

## Implementation

Research via GitHub API (flacomdoc FlaConverter.java) confirmed that scale9Grid is stored in the **Contents stream** (not Symbol N streams), inside the CDocumentPage symbol entry, following a 16-byte F5 pre-scale9Grid anchor pattern.

### flash8-binary.ts changes:
- Added `scale9Grid` field to `Fla8SymbolInfo` interface
- In `parseFla8Contents()` symbol loop: added `linkageFlagsEnd` tracking, then a scale9Grid decode block for `formatVersion >= 0x3F` (Flash 8+) that:
  1. Scans for the 16-byte anchor pattern `[FF FE FF 00][FF FE FF 00][00 00 00 00][FF FE FF 00]` starting from `linkageFlagsEnd` (within a 2000-byte window)
  2. Reads the subsequent 20-byte block: `UI32 toggle + UI32 right + UI32 left + UI32 bottom + UI32 top` (all LE twips)
  3. Sets `scale9Grid` when `toggle === 1`, converting twips to pixels (÷ 20)

### flash8-import.ts changes:
- Added `Scale9Grid` to imports
- In symbol creation loop: converts binary `{left, top, right, bottom}` to model `{x, y, width, height}` and passes to `createSymbol()`

## Tests
Added 3 unit tests in `packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/flash8-import.test.ts`:
- `decodes an enabled scale9Grid with correct pixel coordinates` — verifies toggle=1, twip→px conversion
- `returns null scale9Grid when toggle is 0 (disabled)` — INT_MIN sentinel case
- `returns null scale9Grid when formatVersion is below 0x3F (pre-Flash-8)` — version gate

Run: `pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run`
Result: 4772 passed, 1 pre-existing failure in verify-sounds.test.ts (unrelated)
